units.source: {#1}Attributes{/#1} are a type of gameplay mechanic associated with the level up system in {#2}Battle Brothers{/#2}. Attributes are character stats that affect combat performance. These stats are displayed in the lower left area of the character screen. The numerical values include modifiers from {#3}Backgrounds{/#3}, {#4}Traits{/#4}, and {#5}Equipment{/#5}.
units.zh: {#1}属性{/#1}是{#2}《战场兄弟》{/#2}中与升级系统相关的一项游戏机制，决定角色在战斗中的表现。属性显示在角色界面左下方，其中的数值已计入{#3}背景{/#3}、{#4}特性{/#4}和{#5}装备{/#5}带来的修正。

units.source: What 1-3 stars next to an attribute mean, is explained on the {#1}Talents{/#1} page
units.zh: 属性旁1-3颗星的含义，见{#1}天赋{/#1}词条。

units.zh: {#1}计算方式与更多说明见：{#2}护甲伤害{/#2}{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Head Armor{/#1} is determined by a character's {#2}helmet{/#2} and is reduced by {#3}enemy{/#3} hits to the head.
units.zh: {#1}头部护甲{/#1}由角色佩戴的{#2}头盔{/#2}决定，头部遭到{#3}敌人{/#3}命中时会损失耐久。

units.source: Depending on the incoming {#1}weapon{/#1} skill’s damage and armor ignoring values, some damage can go directly to the {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} hitpoints even with the best head gear equipped. With no or destroyed helmet any hit to the head will cause direct damage to {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} HP.
units.zh: 根据来袭{#1}武器{/#1}技能的伤害和穿甲比例，即使佩戴最好的头部装备，也可能有部分伤害直接扣除{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}生命值。如果没有佩戴头盔，或头盔已经损毁，头部命中造成的伤害就会直接扣除{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}生命值。

units.source: The head of a character is harder to hit than the body, but is more vulnerable to damage.{#1} {/#1}Hits on the head are called {#2}critical hits{/#2} and inflict 50% more {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}HP damage. {#6}One-handed Axes{/#6}' {#7}Chop{/#7} skill deals additional 50% {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} HP damage on top of that. These bonus damages are negated by {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} {#14}Steel Brow{/#14} perk; enemies possessing this perk also negate the {#15}{#16}{#17/}{/#16}{/#15} {#18}Brute{/#18} trait bonus damage of player's mercenaries.

{#1}Head armor{/#1} weighs less than {#2}body armor{/#2} for the same amount of durability, but {#3}Armor Attachments{/#3} cannot be applied. Heavy head armor incurs substantial {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}Vision{/#7} penalty, which may handicap the use of some weapons and items, especially during the {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} {#11}Nighttime{/#11}.
{#1}Body Armor{/#1} value is determined by a character's body armor and is reduced by enemy hits to the body.
units.zh: {#1}身体护甲{/#1}的数值由角色身上的护甲决定，身体受到敌人命中时会损失耐久。

units.source: Depending on the incoming attack’s armor ignoring properties and damage value, some damage can go thru the best body armor directly to the hitpoints. With no or destroyed body armor any hit to the body will cause direct damage to HP.
units.zh: 根据来袭攻击的穿甲特性和伤害，即使是最好的身体护甲，也可能被部分伤害穿透，直接扣除生命值。如果没有护甲，或护甲已经损毁，身体命中造成的伤害就会直接扣除生命值。

units.source: Some of the crafted {#1}Armor Attachments{/#1} reduce the incoming damage of certain types: melee, ranged, armor ignoring damage. Some body armor Attachments give other benefits: permanent acid protection or blocking damage of the first hit once a battle (unless it’s a 100% direct hit to HP).
units.zh: 部分可制作的{#1}护甲附件{/#1}能降低特定类型的伤害，例如近战、远程或穿甲伤害。其他身体护甲附件还可提供不同效果，例如持续防护酸液，或每场战斗挡住首次命中的伤害（完全100%直接作用于生命值的攻击除外）。

units.source: Heavily armored mercenaries can benefit from {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Battle Forged{/#4} perk, which grants 30% armor damage reduction at 300/300 head/body armor setup (alas it has diminishing returns, when the current armor value decreases).
units.zh: 重甲佣兵可以受益于{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}久经战阵{/#4}特长。头部和身体护甲均为300/300时，它能降低30%的护甲伤害；不过随着当前护甲耐久下降，减伤效果也会减弱。

units.source: Heavy armor also comes at the expense of a high penalty to Fatigue and Initiative. This penalty can be decreased with {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Brawny{/#4} perk, which also applies its effects to the head armor. There is a specific Armor Attachment that applies similar effect for the body armor as well.
units.zh: 重甲会大幅降低疲劳上限和先攻。{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}壮硕{/#4}特长可减少这项负担，对头部护甲同样有效。还有一种护甲附件，能对身体护甲产生类似效果。

units.zh: {#1}计算方式与更多说明见：{#2}生命值伤害{/#2}{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Hitpoints{/#1} ({#2}HP{/#2}) represent the health of a character. If this attribute falls to 0, the character is killed or "{#3}struck down{/#3}". Characters with the {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}Survivor{/#7} trait have 90% chance of being {#8}struck down{/#8} instead of getting killed (battle log will show "struck down"), unless they suffer a fatality or already have all the {#9}permanent injuries{/#9}. Characters without the {#10}{#11}{#12/}{/#11}{/#10} {#13}Survivor{/#13} trait have less chances to survive after losing all hitpoints. Being {#14}struck down{/#14} always incurs a {#15}permanent injury{/#15} that can only be removed with the {#16}{#17}{#18/}{/#17}{/#16} {#19}Water Skin{/#19}, which is a legendary item of single quantity.
units.zh: {#1}生命值{/#1}（{#2}HP{/#2}）代表角色的健康状况。生命值降到0时，角色会死亡，或被{#3}击倒{/#3}。具有{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4}{#7}幸存者{/#7}特性的角色，有90%的概率只是{#8}被击倒{/#8}而非死亡，战斗日志会显示“被击倒”；但遭到致命处决，或已拥有全部{#9}永久伤残{/#9}时例外。没有{#10}{#11}{#12/}{/#11}{/#10}{#13}幸存者{/#13}特性的角色，在生命值耗尽后生还的机会更低。{#14}被击倒{/#14}必定留下一个{#15}永久伤残{/#15}，只能用{#16}{#17}{#18/}{/#17}{/#16}{#19}皮水囊{/#19}治愈；这件传奇物品全局只有一份。

units.source: Hitpoints can be lost due to several effects that inflict {#1}Damage over Time (DoT){/#1}. These are: {#2}poison{/#2} (by Webknecht/Poison Oil), {#3}bleed{/#3} (inflicted by cleavers and whips, caused by some wounds), {#4}Miasma{/#4} spell. Poison and bleed effects can be healed by items and mitigated by {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Resilient{/#8} perk ({#9}DoT{/#9} duration is reduced to a minimum of 1 turn). Certain amount of Hitpoints is lost when a character is devoured by a grown {#10}Nachzehrer{/#10}, attacked by {#11}Alps{/#11}’ {#12}Nightmare{/#12}, or touched by {#13}Geists{/#13}.
units.zh: 若干{#1}持续伤害{/#1}效果也会扣除生命值，包括{#2}中毒{/#2}（来自蛛怪或毒油）、{#3}流血{/#3}（由砍刀、鞭子或某些伤势引起）以及{#4}瘴气{/#4}法术。中毒和流血可用物品治疗，也可通过{#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5}{#8}顽强{/#8}特长缓解，使{#9}持续伤害{/#9}的持续时间缩短至最低1回合。角色被长大的{#10}食尸鬼{/#10}吞食、受到{#11}梦魇{/#11}的{#12}噩梦{/#12}攻击，或被{#13}怨魂{/#13}触及时，同样会损失一定生命值。

units.source: Ways to preserve HP, while wearing armor, are most commonly split between picking either {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Battle Forged{/#4} or {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Nimble{/#8} perks. Heavily armored brothers can receive a lot of hits before they start losing hitpoints, but are very susceptible to high {#9}armor ignoring damage{/#9} (AID), e.g. from crossbow bolts and {#10}barbarian{/#10} 2-handed weapons, especially combined with {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} {#14}Crippling Strikes{/#14}. Thus, {#15}{#16}{#17/}{/#16}{/#15} {#18}Additional Fur Padding{/#18} helps weaken this high AID and keep your men alive. {#19}{#20}{#21/}{/#20}{/#19} {#22}Bone Platings{/#22} completely absorb body armor damage from the first hit once a battle, so it helps too. But the most vulnerable spot is the head, which cannot be protected with {#23}armor attachments{/#23} and takes additional damage that can only be negated with {#24}{#25}{#26/}{/#25}{/#24} {#27}Steel Brow{/#27}.

Lightly armored brothers that go Nimble benefit from light-weight, but efficient armor and helmet. They take only 40% of the damage to their hitpoints, if weight is below a certain threshold. Not only do they get less Fatigue penalty from the armor and thus more endurance for fights, but also lose less Initiative which synergizes with defensive perk {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Dodge{/#4}. These kind of mercenaries effectively use their HP as armor, both with its pros and cons. Most notable are: you can swap damaged armor, but health restores very slowly; very susceptible to {#5}DoT{/#5}, especially inflicted by cleavers with Mastery; high and further HP losses mean more negative morale checks. Non-Steel Brow brothers suffer much from 1-handed axes’ attacks to the head too.
units.zh: 选择轻灵的轻甲兄弟适合穿戴重量轻、耐久效率高的护甲和头盔。装备负重低于相应门槛时，他们只承受40%的生命值伤害。较低的护甲疲劳惩罚不仅能提高战斗续航，也能保留更多先攻，与防御特长{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}闪避{/#4}配合。这类佣兵实际上是在用生命值充当护甲，因此也有明显的利弊：损坏的护甲可以更换，生命值却恢复得很慢；他们很怕{#5}持续伤害{/#5}，尤其是精通砍刀的敌人造成的流血；单次和后续损失大量生命值，还会带来更多不利的士气检定。没有钢铁额骨的兄弟也很怕单手斧命中头部。

units.source: Enemies reduced to 0 HP are always killed, unless they possess {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Nine Lives{/#4} perk, which restores little health pool and removes any applied poison and/or bleeding. {#5}Wiedergangers{/#5} can come back to life if not killed by decapitation or fatality, {#6}Fallen Heroes{/#6} self-reanimate even in the headless state. {#7}Necromancer{/#7} can reanimate any humans to fight for him (your dead mercenaries included). On the other hand, "{#8}struck down{/#8}" Brothers can't be eaten by {#9}Nachzehrers{/#9} or reanimated by {#10}Necromancers{/#10}. At some point player will gain the {#11}Obsidian Dagger{/#11} that will allow him to reanimate any humans killed with it to fight along his company's side.
units.zh: 敌人生命值降到0时必定死亡，除非具有{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}九命{/#4}特长：它能恢复少量生命值，并清除中毒和流血。{#5}行尸{/#5}如果不是被斩首或以致命处决杀死，就可能复活；{#6}陨落英雄{/#6}即使没有头也能自行复活。{#7}亡灵法师{/#7}可以复活人类尸体为其作战，包括你死去的佣兵。相反，只是{#8}被击倒{/#8}的兄弟不会被{#9}食尸鬼{/#9}吃掉，也不会被{#10}亡灵法师{/#10}复活。玩家之后可以获得{#11}黑曜石匕首{/#11}，用它杀死的人类会复活，并为你的佣兵团作战。

units.source: During one of the possible end-game crises - {#1}Undead Scourge{/#1} - killed humans reanimate on their own, and {#2}Zombies{/#2} often come together with {#3}Ancient Dead{/#3}. Be advised that a {#4}Necromancer{/#4} possesses powers to also reanimate killed skeletons.
units.zh: 在一种可能发生的后期危机——{#1}亡灵灾祸{/#1}期间，死去的人类会自行复活，{#2}行尸{/#2}也常与{#3}远古亡灵{/#3}一同出现。还需注意，{#4}亡灵法师{/#4}也能复活被击败的骷髅。

units.source: Certain backgrounds ({#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Hedge Knight{/#4}, {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Wildman{/#8}, {#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}Lumberjack{/#12}, {#13}{#14}{#15/}{/#14}{/#13} {#16}Miner{/#16}, {#17}{#18}{#19/}{/#18}{/#17} {#20}Brawler{/#20}) have higher initial HP pool and can come with {#21}{#22}{#23/}{/#22}{/#21} {#24}Tough{/#24} trait. Other backgrounds ({#25}{#26}{#27/}{/#26}{/#25} {#28}Cripple{/#28}, {#29}{#30}{#31/}{/#30}{/#29} {#32}Beggar{/#32}) have the least hitpoints, and are excluded from positive health trait and talent, and may possess negative {#33}{#34}{#35/}{/#34}{/#33} {#36}Fragile{/#36} trait. Some ({#37}{#38}{#39/}{/#38}{/#37} {#40}Retired Soldier{/#40}, {#41}{#42}{#43/}{/#42}{/#41} {#44}Swordmaster{/#44}) have generally low health pool and are excluded from {#45}{#46}{#47/}{/#46}{/#45} {#48}Tough{/#48} trait, but can never be {#49}{#50}{#51/}{/#50}{/#49} {#52}Fragile{/#52} and cannot be excluded from health talent.

Certain {#1}injuries{/#1} reduce HP pool, either temporarily or permanently, depending on the injury. Strong health pool reduces chances to receive injuries and helps maintain good morale during combat upon losing hitpoints.
units.zh: 某些{#1}伤势{/#1}会暂时或永久降低生命值上限，具体取决于伤势类型。较高的生命值能降低受伤概率，也更有利于在战斗中损失生命值后维持士气。

units.source: On the world map lost hitpoints are recovered at a rate of 1HP/hour on march and 2HP/hour while camping or escorting a caravan. {#1}The Cook{/#1} increases hitpoint healing rate by 33%.
units.zh: 在世界地图上，行军时每小时恢复1点生命值，扎营或护送商队时每小时恢复2点。{#1}厨师{/#1}能将生命值恢复速度提高33%。

units.source: {#1}Action Points{/#1} ({#2}AP{/#2}) are used in combat to perform different kinds of actions and movement.
units.zh: {#1}行动点{/#1}（{#2}AP{/#2}）用于在战斗中执行各种行动和移动。

units.source: Different units possess a varying number of Action Points. A certain amount of AP is required to perform a specific action or move. When AP reach 0, the turn for the character ends, and the next unit acts ({#1}auto-end turns{/#1} feature can be disabled in the options menu). Action Points fully recover every round unless a unit is stunned or affected by goblin poison or by a certain injury.
units.zh: 不同单位拥有的行动点可能不同，每次行动或移动都需要消耗相应的行动点。行动点降到0时，该角色的回合结束，由下一个单位行动；可在设置中关闭{#1}自动结束回合{/#1}功能。除非受到眩晕、地精毒液或特定伤势影响，否则行动点每轮都会完全恢复。

units.source: The only ways to work around the limited amount of Action Points are to either conserve or regain them. Most common action, beside attacking, is movement. Difficult terrain and changing height levels negatively impact AP availability and thus tactics options: {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Pathfinder{/#4} substantially helps mitigate the impact.
units.zh: 应对行动点有限的办法，是节省消耗或恢复行动点。除了攻击，最常见的行动就是移动。复杂地形和高低差会消耗更多行动点，限制战术选择；{#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1}{#4}寻路者{/#4}能显著减轻这种影响。

units.source: As for the combat part of battle, {#1}Mastery{/#1} perks make some tactics available with certain weapons – {#2}Polearms{/#2} and {#3}Daggers{/#3} – by reducing AP cost of their skills. Additional opportunities come with {#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4} {#7}Berserk{/#7} perk, which restores 4 AP upon enemy kill (though it activates only once per round). When a situation dictates a different approach, a weapon or an item can be switched without losing AP with {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} {#11}Quick Hands{/#11} (it works only once per round, {#12}auto-end turns{/#12} feature can specifically be disabled for that; limitation - any swap to/from a shield does require a standard amount of AP).
units.zh: 战斗中，{#1}武器精通{/#1}特长会降低某些武器的技能行动点消耗，从而解锁更多战术，典型例子是{#2}长柄武器{/#2}和{#3}匕首{/#3}。{#4}{#5}{#6/}{/#5}{/#4}{#7}狂战{/#7}在击杀敌人后恢复4点行动点，每轮只触发一次。需要调整打法时，{#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8}{#11}快手{/#11}可让你每轮一次免费更换武器或物品，也可以为此关闭{#12}自动结束回合{/#12}。但换上或换下盾牌仍需支付正常的行动点。

units.source: {#1}Fatigue{/#1} determines how exhausted a character is. Using either skills or movement will not only use up Action Points, but will also build up Fatigue. A character will not able to move or execute any skills, if too much Fatigue is accumulated.
units.zh: {#1}疲劳{/#1}代表角色的疲惫程度。使用技能和移动除了消耗行动点，还会积累疲劳。疲劳过高时，角色将无法移动或使用技能。

units.source: Fatigue recovers for a basic amount of 15 every round. It can be regained at a faster pace with {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Iron Lungs{/#4}, or slower for {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Asthmatic{/#8}. Fatigue build-up while moving is reduced for {#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}Athletic{/#12} and {#13}{#14}{#15/}{/#14}{/#13} {#16}Pathfinder{/#16}, in combat - by picking up {#17}Weapon Masteries{/#17}. {#18}{#19}{#20/}{/#19}{/#18} {#21}Second Wind Potion{/#21} helps recover more Fatigue after use. More drastic and efficient: {#22}{#23}{#24/}{/#23}{/#22} {#25}Recover{/#25} perk.

Being hit by melee or ranged weapon builds up 5 Fatigue, 10 and 20 if hit by one- and two-handed maces respectively. Dodging or blocking melee attacks with a shield builds up 2 Fatigue points. Some enemies’ attacks build up more Fatigue on targets they hit (e.g. {#1}Fallen Heroes{/#1} deal double fatigue damage, as well as {#2}Armored Wiedergangers{/#2} after day 20). Dodging or blocking ranged attacks does not incur Fatigue build-up.
units.zh: 被近战或远程武器命中通常会积累5点疲劳；被单手锤和双手锤命中时，则分别积累10和20点。躲开近战攻击或用盾牌格挡，会积累2点疲劳。部分敌人的攻击会使目标承受更多疲劳，例如{#1}陨落英雄{/#1}造成双倍疲劳伤害，20天后的{#2}披甲行尸{/#2}也是如此。躲开或格挡远程攻击不会积累疲劳。

units.source: Orc weapons and shields have higher penalty to Fatigue on equip than their equivalents and also build up additional 5 Fatigue points for every skill when used by humans.
units.zh: 兽人武器和盾牌的装备疲劳惩罚高于同类装备；人类使用它们时，每次技能还会额外积累5点疲劳。

units.source: Some recruits ({#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Wildman{/#4}, {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Farmhand{/#8}, {#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}Lumberjack{/#12}, {#13}{#14}{#15/}{/#14}{/#13} {#16}Hedge Knight{/#16}) have higher initial Fatigue reserves and can possess Fatigue-positive traits ( {#17}{#18}{#19/}{/#18}{/#17} {#20}Strong{/#20}, {#21}{#22}{#23/}{/#22}{/#21} {#24}Iron Lungs{/#24}), while others ({#25}{#26}{#27/}{/#26}{/#25} {#28}Swordmaster{/#28}, {#29}{#30}{#31/}{/#30}{/#29} {#32}Retired Soldier{/#32}, {#33}{#34}{#35/}{/#34}{/#33} {#36}Miner{/#36}) generally start with less Fatigue reserves and are excluded from Fatigue-positive traits.

Most mid- and high-tier enemies restore more fatigue per turn than player's mercenaries, and some strong opponents possess passive Battle Flow skill that lowers accumulated fatigue upon kill. Besides, {#1}Barbarians{/#1} tend to rely on {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} {#5}Dodge{/#5} and {#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} {#9}Relentless{/#9} perks and often have {#10}Drummer{/#10} support unit, which lowers accumulated Fatigue of his teammates. {#11}Zombies{/#11} (except Necromancer) and {#12}Ancient Dead{/#12} do not accumulate Fatigue at all.
units.zh: 多数中高阶敌人每轮恢复的疲劳比玩家佣兵更多，一些强敌还拥有击杀后降低已积累疲劳的被动技能“战斗节奏”。{#1}蛮族{/#1}常依赖{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}{#5}闪避{/#5}与{#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6}{#9}不懈{/#9}特长，并经常有{#10}鼓手{/#10}支援，为同伴降低已积累的疲劳。{#11}行尸类敌人{/#11}（亡灵法师除外）和{#12}远古亡灵{/#12}完全不会积累疲劳。

units.source: Morale has six states and represents the mental condition of combatants and their effectiveness in battle. Unbreakable state is exclusive to {#1}Undead{/#1}, and can not be changed. Steady is the default state, and non-undead enemies start with it and it can raise and lower as they pass or fail morale checks. Brothers' morale depends on their {#2}mood{/#2}: good mood gives a chance to start with Confident morale, and bad mood lowers the maximum possible level of morale the brother can have. Some {#3}traits{/#3} also affect starting morale or its maximum.
units.zh: 士气共有六种状态，反映战斗人员的精神状况，并影响战斗表现。“不可动摇”是{#1}亡灵{/#1}专属且不会改变的状态。“镇定”是默认状态，非亡灵敌人通常以此开战，之后会随士气检定成功或失败而升降。兄弟的初始士气受{#2}心情{/#2}影响：心情好时有机会以“斗志昂扬”开战，心情差则会降低其能达到的士气上限。某些{#3}特性{/#3}也会影响初始士气或士气上限。

units.source: If morale drops to Fleeing, the unit cancels its active {#1}Shieldwall{/#1}, {#2}Spearwall{/#2}, {#3}Riposte{/#3} and {#4}Indomitable{/#4}, is also instantly moved to the end of turn order. At the start of a round Fleeing units have a penalty of -1000 initiative for turn order only, so they will act last, if not under {#5}Adrenaline{/#5}. Fleeing units try to run away from enemies and can't fight or use skills, and even don't fight if surrounded. Player loses control over fleeing brothers. Fleeing units can rally on their own when not adjacent to enemies, or if targeted by skills like {#6}Rally the Troops{/#6} that restore their morale.
units.zh: 士气降至“溃逃”时，单位会取消已启用的{#1}盾墙{/#1}、{#2}矛墙{/#2}、{#3}还击架势{/#3}和{#4}不屈{/#4}，并立即移到行动顺序末尾。每轮开始时，溃逃单位会在行动排序计算中受到-1000先攻惩罚，因此通常最后行动，除非使用了{#5}肾上腺素{/#5}。他们会试图远离敌人，无法战斗或使用技能，即使被包围也不会还击。玩家无法控制溃逃的兄弟。未与敌人相邻时，他们可能自行重整；受到{#6}重振士气{/#6}等技能影响时，也可以恢复士气。

units.source: Morale states apply multipliers to some {#1}attributes{/#1} as shown below. They count after additive bonuses from skills, perks and equipment, affecting them as well. Some states are indicated by icons.
units.zh: 各士气状态会按下表为部分{#1}属性{/#1}施加倍率。这些倍率在技能、特长和装备的加算加成之后计算，因此也会影响这些加成。部分士气状态会显示图标。

units.source: {#1}Resolve{/#1} represents the willpower and bravery of characters. High Resolve makes it less likely that characters fall to lower morale states due to negative events and the more likely that characters gain confidence from positive events. Resolve acts as defense against certain mental attacks that inflict panic, fear or mind control. Resolve also affects the ability of a character to rally (leave the Fleeing morale state) and the effectiveness of the {#2}Rally the Troops{/#2} perk. High resolve prevents sleep status applied by alps and lowers their nightmare damage to brothers in sleep state.
units.zh: {#1}意志{/#1}代表角色的意志和勇气。意志越高，越不容易因不利事件降低士气，也越容易因有利事件变得自信。意志还能抵御恐慌、恐惧和精神控制等心灵攻击，影响角色从溃逃状态中重整的能力，以及{#2}重振士气{/#2}特长的效果。较高意志有助于抵抗梦魇施加的睡眠，并降低沉睡时受到的噩梦伤害。

units.source: {#1}Initiative{/#1} is a secondary attribute that determines turn order of characters on the battlefield. The higher this value, the earlier the position in the turn order. In general, someone in light armor will act before someone in heavy armor, and someone fresh will act before someone fatigued. The average Battle Brother has a value around 100, which is reduced by the current fatigue as well as any penalty to maximum fatigue (such as from heavy armor and weapons, other equipment).
units.zh: {#1}先攻{/#1}是决定战场行动顺序的一项次要属性，数值越高，行动越早。一般来说，轻甲单位比重甲单位先行动，精力充沛的单位比疲惫的单位先行动。普通兄弟的基础先攻约为100；当前疲劳和所有疲劳上限惩罚（如重甲、武器及其他装备的负担）都会降低先攻。

units.source: Apart from its main purpose, Initiative has other uses and can benefit from some perks. The most apparent benefit comes with {#1}Dodge{/#1} perk, which allows to boost both Melee and Ranged Defense by 15% of the current Initiative value. {#2}Relentless{/#2} perk serves as a complimentary measure to capitalize on Initiative-Defense boost, as well as to maintain a certain strategic turn order.
units.zh: 除了决定行动顺序，先攻还可与一些特长配合。最直接的是{#1}闪避{/#1}，它将当前先攻的15%加到近战和远程防御上。{#2}不懈{/#2}有助于维持这种防御收益，也方便维持战术所需的行动顺序。

units.source: And last, but by far not the least Initiative related perk, is {#1}Adrenaline{/#1}. It guarantees early actions next turn, but turn order among Adrenaline users is still governed by the current Initiative value.
units.zh: 另一个重要的先攻相关特长是{#1}肾上腺素{/#1}。它能保证下一轮提前行动，但多个使用肾上腺素的单位之间，仍按当前先攻决定顺序。

units.source: {#1}For hit-chance calculation and further info see: {#2}Combat Mechanics{/#2}{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}命中率计算方式与更多说明见：{#2}战斗机制{/#2}{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Melee Skill{/#1} determines the base probability of hitting a target with a melee attack, such as with swords and spears. Can be increased as the character gains experience.
units.zh: {#1}近战命中{/#1}决定用剑、矛等近战武器攻击目标时的基础命中率。角色升级时可以提升这项属性。

units.source: {#1}Ranged Skill{/#1} determines the base probability of hitting a target with a ranged attack. It defines a hit chance for bows, crossbows, handgonne, firelance and all sort of throwing weapons. Can be increased by allocating attribute points as the character gains experience levels, and by picking up {#2}Gifted{/#2} perk for that purpose as well.
units.zh: {#1}远程命中{/#1}决定远程攻击的基础命中率，适用于弓、弩、火铳、火矛和各种投掷武器。角色升级时可以分配属性点提高它，也可以选择{#2}天赋异禀{/#2}来获得额外提升。

units.source: Apart from leveling up Ranged Skill stat and some rare {#1}events{/#1} that have marginal impact, there is only one factor that improves it substantially, though temporarily: a Confident Morale state (10% boost). On the contrary, low Morale state effects Ranged Skill in a negative way (until morale state is improved).
units.zh: 除了升级提高远程命中，以及少数影响较小的{#1}事件{/#1}，能显著但暂时提高远程命中的因素只有斗志昂扬士气状态（提高10%）。相反，较低士气会降低远程命中，直到士气恢复。

units.source: Moreover, there are more factors that handicap Ranged Skill: {#1}Nighttime{/#1}, {#2}injuries{/#2}, {#3}Swarm of Insects{/#3} and other {#4}Status Effects{/#4}. Some of them can be mitigated, while others - cannot.
units.zh: 此外，{#1}夜间{/#1}、{#2}伤势{/#2}、{#3}虫群{/#3}和其他{#4}状态效果{/#4}也会降低远程命中。其中一些影响可以缓解，另一些则无法缓解。

units.source: {#1}Melee Defense{/#1} reduces the probability of being hit by melee attacks. It can be increased as the character gains experience and by equipping a good shield and acquiring {#2}Shield Expert{/#2} perk (+25% of the shield defense bonus). Use a shieldwall (and even more with additional shieldwalls adjacency bonus applied). Confident morale status also boosts this attribute. {#3}Dodge{/#3} perk adds up more defense, dependent on current Initiative value. {#4}Reach Advantage{/#4} perk after hitting opponents with two-handed melee weapon provides boost as well. And, {#5}Underdog{/#5} perk cancels enemies' surround to-hit bonus or {#6}Backstabber{/#6} perk, thus improving the defense. {#7}Lone Wolf{/#7} perk has defense benefits, though activates only at certain conditions.
units.zh: {#1}近战防御{/#1}能降低被近战攻击命中的概率，可通过升级、装备合适的盾牌，以及学习{#2}盾牌精通{/#2}来提高；后者使盾牌的防御加成增加+25%。使用盾墙也能提高防御，与其他盾墙相邻时还有额外收益。斗志昂扬士气同样会提高此属性。{#3}闪避{/#3}按当前先攻提供额外防御，{#4}长兵优势{/#4}则在双手近战武器命中后提供加成。{#5}以少敌多{/#5}会抵消敌人的包围命中加成及{#6}背刺者{/#6}带来的相关收益。{#7}孤狼{/#7}也能提高防御，但需要满足特定条件。

units.source: Ranged Defense reduces the probability of being hit with a ranged attack, such as an arrow shot from afar. It can be increased as the character gains experience and by equipping a good shield.
units.zh: 远程防御能降低被箭矢等远程攻击命中的概率，可通过升级和装备合适的盾牌来提高。

units.source: Some recruits’ backgrounds and traits can impact Ranged defense resulting in negative values. Most common examples are {#1}Adventurous Noble{/#1} (with {#2}Cocky{/#2}) and {#3}Wildman{/#3} (with {#4}Huge{/#4}).
units.zh: 某些背景和特性会使远程防御降为负数。常见例子是具有{#2}自负{/#2}特性的{#1}游历贵族{/#1}，以及具有{#4}高大{/#4}特性的{#3}荒野人{/#3}。

units.source: Substantial boost to Ranged defense is achieved by equipping an appropriate ({#1}Kite{/#1} or {#2}Sipar{/#2}) shield and using Shieldwall skill (which effectively doubles the defense bonus granted by shield). Moreover, taking {#3}Shield Expert{/#3} perk raises shield defense values by 25% and also gives this increase for Shieldwall. Maintaining a Shieldwall formation adds flat +5 defense for every adjacent companion with active skill.
units.zh: 装备合适的盾牌，如{#1}鸢形盾{/#1}或{#2}西帕尔圆盾{/#2}，再使用盾墙，可以显著提高远程防御；盾墙实际上会使盾牌提供的防御加成翻倍。{#3}盾牌精通{/#3}还能将盾牌防御提高25%，盾墙也享受这项提升。维持盾墙阵形时，每名相邻且正在使用盾墙的同伴，还会提供固定+5防御。

units.source: Mercenary’s Ranged Defense can be improved with some perks. {#1}Dodge{/#1} perk can benefit lightly armored units: 15% of the current Initiative value is added to the current defense. As Initiative decreases with a flow of the battle, so does the {#2}Dodge{/#2} benefit. Fatigue’s negative influence on Initiative and, hence on Dodge defense bonus, can partially be circumvented by {#3}Relentless{/#3} perk, or {#4}Recover{/#4}. There is also a dedicated Ranged defense perk – {#5}Anticipation{/#5}, which effectiveness adheres to the current Ranged defense value and the distance from shooter.
units.zh: 一些特长也能提高远程防御。{#1}闪避{/#1}适合轻甲单位，将当前先攻的15%加到防御上；随着战斗推进、先攻下降，{#2}闪避{/#2}收益也会降低。{#3}不懈{/#3}或{#4}恢复体力{/#4}能部分缓解疲劳对先攻及闪避防御加成的影响。另有专门针对远程防御的{#5}预判{/#5}特长，效果取决于当前远程防御和与射手的距离。

units.source: There are many factors that can influence Ranged defense of units. {#1}Nighttime{/#1} decreases Ranged defense by -30% and can be negated by {#2}Night Owl Elixir{/#2} (by some opponents as well). Being rooted results in -35% ({#3}Trapped in Vines{/#3}) or -45% ({#4}Throwing Nets{/#4}) penalty, while {#5}Swarm of Insects{/#5} decreases defense by -50%.
units.zh: 许多因素会影响远程防御。{#1}夜间{/#1}造成-30%远程防御修正，可用{#2}夜枭灵药{/#2}抵消，部分敌人也会使用它。{#3}藤蔓束缚{/#3}造成-35%惩罚，{#4}投网{/#4}造成-45%惩罚；{#5}虫群{/#5}则造成-50%惩罚。

units.source: Some character traits and deriving status effects have impact too: {#1}Drunk{/#1} (-25%), {#2}Hangover{/#2} (-10%), {#3}Addict{/#3} (-10%) – these can be gained, and also removed/treated. Temporary (Permanent) {#4}injuries{/#4} have debuffs to Ranged defense also. Consuming {#5}Strange Mushrooms{/#5} not only makes mercenaries hit harder, but also makes them more susceptible to attacks.
units.zh: 某些特性及其衍生状态也会影响远程防御，包括{#1}醉酒{/#1}（-25%）、{#2}宿醉{/#2}（-10%）和{#3}药瘾{/#3}（-10%）；这些状态可能获得，也可以消除或治疗。临时或永久{#4}伤势{/#4}也可能降低远程防御。食用{#5}奇异蘑菇{/#5}虽然能增强攻击，却也会让佣兵更容易被命中。

units.source: Confident morale state grants +10% bonus to cumulative defense value, whereas morale state lower than Steady gives -10%/-20%/-30% penalty.
units.zh: 斗志昂扬士气会使累计防御获得+10%加成，低于镇定的士气状态则分别施加-10%/-20%/-30%惩罚。

units.source: And, finally, taking higher position than a shooting enemy lowers enemies’ chance to hit, which is as good as higher Ranged defense. Taking cover decreases opponent's hit chance even further, though it can be somewhat mitigated by {#1}Bullseye{/#1} perk.
units.zh: 最后，占据比敌方射手更高的位置，可以降低对方的命中率，效果相当于提高远程防御。利用掩体还能进一步降低命中率，但{#1}鹰眼{/#1}特长能部分抵消掩体的作用。

units.source: {#1}Damage{/#1} attribute denotes the base damage the currently equipped weapon does. Will be applied in full against hitpoints if no armor is protecting the target. If the target is protected by armor, the damage is applied to armor instead based on the weapon's effectiveness against armor. Depending on how much damage is done, some of the damage might go directly through the worn armor to the hitpoints. The actual damage done is modified by the skill used and the target hit.
units.zh: {#1}伤害{/#1}属性表示当前武器的基础伤害。目标没有护甲时，伤害会完全作用于生命值；目标有护甲时，则先依据武器的破甲效率对护甲造成伤害。根据伤害数值，部分伤害可能穿过护甲，直接扣除生命值。实际伤害还受所用技能和命中目标影响。

units.source: This parameter can be influenced by a fair variety of factors. Firstly, by Traits. Damage is increased for {#1}Huge{/#1}, {#2}Drunkard{/#2} and {#3}Brute{/#3} characters, and decreased for {#4}Tiny{/#4}. Secondly, Double Gripping one-handed weapons results in +25% damage increase, which excellently synergizes with {#5}Duelist{/#5} perk. Ranged weapon users have their own counterparts - {#6}Crossbow Mastery{/#6} and {#7}Throwing Mastery{/#7} (also benefits from {#8}Duelist{/#8}) perks. On top of that, killing an enemy grants some bonus damage (+25%, {#9}Killing Frenzy{/#9}) or hitting an injured opponent deals more damage to the target (+20%, {#10}Executioner{/#10}). And, finally, there are {#11}Strange Mushrooms{/#11}, which seriously boost melee damage during the combat.
units.zh: 许多因素会影响伤害。首先是特性：{#1}高大{/#1}、{#2}酒鬼{/#2}和{#3}蛮力{/#3}会提高伤害，{#4}矮小{/#4}则会降低伤害。其次，双手握持单手武器能增加+25%伤害，与{#5}决斗家{/#5}配合良好。远程武器也有对应的{#6}弩精通{/#6}和{#7}投掷精通{/#7}，投掷武器同样可以受益于{#8}决斗家{/#8}。此外，{#9}杀戮狂热{/#9}在击杀后增加+25%伤害，{#10}刽子手{/#10}对受伤目标增加+20%伤害。{#11}奇异蘑菇{/#11}则能在战斗中大幅提高近战伤害。

units.source: On the other hand, there are means to reduce incoming Damage. This can be achieved with heavy armor in conjunction with {#1}Battle Forged{/#1} perk and/or {#2}Armor Attachments{/#2}. As a light armor counterpart, there is {#3}Nimble{/#3}. Some situations call for drastic measures, and this is {#4}Indomitable{/#4}. Additional Damage to Hitpoints with Critical hits and also with head hits by one-handed axes can also be mitigated, with {#5}Steel Brow{/#5} perk.
units.zh: 防御方面，重甲可以配合{#1}久经战阵{/#1}或{#2}护甲附件{/#2}来减轻伤害，轻甲路线则有{#3}轻灵{/#3}。需要强力防护时，可以使用{#4}不屈{/#4}。暴击和单手斧命中头部带来的额外生命值伤害，可以由{#5}钢铁额骨{/#5}抵消。

units.source: Besides, some injuries and status effects influence Damage as well. Some enemies gain additional damage: in combat (with skills) and as campaign gets older.
units.zh: 某些伤势和状态效果也会影响伤害。一些敌人还会通过战斗技能，或随着战役天数推进，获得额外伤害。

units.source: There is a separate category of damage, and this is {#1}Damage over Time{/#1} (DoT). This type of damage is related primarily to poison and bleed procs, which can be countered by similar defensive measures and items. These DoT are modified by some perks and/or traits and mainly mitigated by {#2}Resilient{/#2} perk: it reduces this type of damage (and other status effects) to just 1 turn duration. Damage coming from Fire and Miasma spell can be cancelled by {#3}Smoke Pot{/#3}.
units.zh: 还有一类独立的{#1}持续伤害{/#1}，主要来自中毒和流血，可用相应的防护措施及物品应对。部分特长或特性会改变这些效果，而{#2}顽强{/#2}能将其及其他状态效果的持续时间缩短至1回合。火焰和瘴气造成的伤害可用{#3}烟雾罐{/#3}消除。

units.source: {#1}Effectiveness vs. Armor{/#1} denotes the base percentage of damage that will be applied when hitting a target protected by armor. Once the armor is destroyed, the weapon damage applies at 100% to hitpoints. The actual damage done is modified by the skill used and the target hit.
units.zh: {#1}破甲效率{/#1}表示攻击有护甲目标时，基础伤害以多大比例作用于护甲。护甲被摧毁后，武器伤害会以100%的比例作用于生命值。实际伤害还受所用技能和命中目标影响。

units.source: Effectiveness against Armor as a weapon parameter is governed by the weapon properties, weapon skill and, sometimes, Mastery perk. For example, {#1}Hammer Mastery{/#1} perk in conjunction with {#2}hammers{/#2}' Destroy / Demolish Armor skills.
units.zh: 作为武器参数，破甲效率取决于武器本身、使用的技能，有时也受精通特长影响。例如，{#1}战锤精通{/#1}会与{#2}战锤{/#2}的破甲和碎甲技能配合。

units.source: Effectiveness against Armor as an armor damage value is influenced by many factors, similarly to overall Damage parameter, though with some distinctions.
units.zh: 从实际护甲伤害来看，破甲效果也受许多因素影响，与总体伤害参数相似，但有一些区别。

units.source: Some traits influence overall damage, hence the resulting armor damage is modified by that value. Double Gripping vs armor results in more damage too. Ranged units have {#1}Throwing Mastery{/#1} for armor damage boosting as well (at 2-3 tile range). {#2}Killing Frenzy{/#2} and {#3}Executioner{/#3} give bonus both to HP and armor damage. And, at last, a single use item buff from {#4}Strange Mushrooms{/#4} can help tear some heavy armor off.
units.zh: 有些特性会影响总体伤害，因而也会改变最终护甲伤害；双手握持同样能提高对护甲的伤害。远程单位可通过{#1}投掷精通{/#1}在2-3格距离提高破甲伤害。{#2}杀戮狂热{/#2}和{#3}刽子手{/#3}同时提高生命值伤害和护甲伤害。一次性使用的{#4}奇异蘑菇{/#4}也有助于击破重甲。

units.source: On the defensive side, we have some overall damage mitigating {#1}Armor Attachments{/#1} and {#2}Battle Forged{/#2}. And, of course, {#3}Indomitable{/#3} defense bonus from incoming overall damage.
units.zh: 防御方面，可以使用减轻总体伤害的{#1}护甲附件{/#1}和{#2}久经战阵{/#2}，以及{#3}不屈{/#3}带来的整体减伤。

units.source: {#1}For calculation and further info see: {#2}To-Hit Chance{/#2}{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}计算方式与更多说明见：{#2}命中率{/#2}{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Chance to hit head{/#1} denotes the base percentage chance to hit a target's head for increased HP damage. Though, this additional damage can be completely negated by {#2}Steel Brow{/#2} perk.
units.zh: {#1}命中头部概率{/#1}表示攻击命中目标头部的基础概率；命中头部会提高生命值伤害，但这部分额外伤害可被{#2}钢铁额骨{/#2}完全抵消。

units.source: The resulting chance to hit head is modified by some factors: weapon used, weapon skill, {#1}Brute{/#1} trait and backgrounds ({#2}Killer on the Run{/#2}, {#3}Juggler{/#3}). Moreover, there is a specialized perk for getting more critical hits - {#4}Head Hunter{/#4}.
units.zh: 最终命中头部概率受武器、技能、{#1}蛮力{/#1}特性以及{#2}在逃杀人犯{/#2}、{#3}杂耍艺人{/#3}等背景影响。另外还有专门提高头部命中机会的{#4}猎首者{/#4}特长。

units.source: {#1}For vision ranged hit-chance influence and further info see: {#2}Combat Mechanics{/#2}{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}视野对远程命中率的影响及更多说明见：{#2}战斗机制{/#2}{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Vision{/#1}, or view range, determines how far a character can see to uncover the fog of war, discover threats and hit with ranged and long-reach melee attacks.
units.zh: {#1}视野{/#1}也就是可视距离，决定角色能看多远、揭开多大范围的战争迷雾，以及在多远处发现威胁并使用远程或长距离近战攻击。

units.source: An obvious Vision limiting factor is {#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Nighttime{/#4}. Heavier {#5}helmets{/#5} can reduce Vision. Certain {#6}Traits{/#6} ({#7}{#8}{#9/}{/#8}{/#7} {#10}Short Sighted{/#10}, {#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} {#14}Night Blind{/#14}) or {#15}Injuries{/#15} can also impact it. Additionally, being affected by {#16}{#17}{#18/}{/#17}{/#16} {#19}Goblin Poison{/#19} temporary limits view range as well. Vision cannot be reduced below 1. Elevation is taken into account after the cap, so it is possible to stand on higher ground and see and attack beyond 1 tile, even with every possible debuff.

Commonly, a hired mercenary has a Vision value of 7. One way to increase the view range, besides having positive Vision traits ({#1}{#2}{#3/}{/#2}{/#1} {#4}Eagle Eyes{/#4}, {#5}{#6}{#7/}{/#6}{/#5} {#8}Night Owl{/#8}) and {#9}{#10}{#11/}{/#10}{/#9} {#12}Bow Mastery{/#12} perk, is to occupy a higher elevation tile. Though, this gain is applied only vs lower positioned opponents (or terrain).
Battle Brothers can be thought of as a turn based simulator of medieval/light fantasy battles.
units.zh: 《战场兄弟》可以看作一款以中世纪和轻度奇幻为背景的回合制战斗模拟游戏。

units.source: As with many turn based strategy games, it can be split into 2 parts:{#1/}
units.zh: 与许多回合制策略游戏一样，它可以分为2个部分：{#1/}

units.source: 'turn based' {#1}combat{/#1} or tactical part on a hex tiled battlefield{#2/}
units.zh: 在六角格战场上进行的回合制{#1}战斗{/#1}，也就是战术部分{#2/}

units.source: 'real time with pause' management or strategy part on the {#1}overland map{/#1} and {#2}settlements{/#2}
units.zh: 在{#1}世界地图{/#1}和{#2}定居点{/#2}中进行的可暂停即时经营，也就是战略部分

units.source: The player starts the game with 3 men, will {#1}hire{/#1} more from settlements (up to 20) and can field a maximum of 12 men in battles. All men require gold and {#2}provisions{/#2} for upkeep.
units.zh: 玩家开局拥有3名佣兵，之后可在定居点{#1}招募{/#1}更多成员，队伍最多可容纳20人，每场战斗最多派出12人。所有成员都需要金币和{#2}食物{/#2}来维持。

units.source: As the player progresses through the game, 3 general parameters are improved:{#1/}
units.zh: 随着游戏推进，佣兵团主要会在3个方面成长：{#1/}

units.source: {#1}XP{/#1} (earned from battles and, to lesser extent, in events) which leads to more {#2}levels{/#2}, {#3}stats{/#3} and {#4}perks{/#4} for the men{#5/}
units.zh: {#1}经验值{/#1}：主要通过战斗获得，部分事件也会给予。经验使兄弟提升{#2}等级{/#2}、增强{#3}属性{/#3}并获得{#4}特长{/#4}{#5/}

units.source: Gold (earned from completing contracts, battles and selling items) which is used to hire men, purchase {#1}supplies{/#1} (tools, medicine, food) and also better {#2}weapons{/#2}, {#3}armor{/#3}, equipment{#4/}
units.zh: 金币：通过完成委托、战斗和出售物品获得，可用于招募成员、购买{#1}补给{/#1}（工具、药品、食物），以及更好的{#2}武器{/#2}、{#3}护甲{/#3}和其他装备{#4/}

units.source: {#1}Renown{/#1} which modifies contract payout and {#2}Relations{/#2} with various settlements which modify buying and selling prices
units.zh: {#1}声望{/#1}影响委托报酬；与各定居点的{#2}关系{/#2}影响买卖价格

units.source: On higher {#1}combat difficulty{/#1} harder enemy groups appear sooner.
units.zh: {#1}战斗难度{/#1}越高，强大的敌人队伍出现得越早。

units.source: On Beginner combat difficulty player gets 5 points lower (better) "to hit" rolls and enemies get 5 points worse ones.{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}1{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}
units.zh: 在新手战斗难度下，玩家的命中判定掷骰结果降低5点（更有利），敌人的结果则向不利方向调整5点。{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}1{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}

units.source: Beginner combat difficulty and Ironman mode delay the {#1}late game crisis{/#1} by 5 days each.
units.zh: 新手战斗难度和铁人模式会各自将{#1}后期危机{/#1}推迟5天。

units.source: Combat difficulty determines defense bonus for moving through zones of control during auto-retreat.{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}2{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}{#5}{#6}{#7}[{/#7}3{#8}]{/#8}{/#6}{/#5}
Increasing Economic difficulty makes contracts pay 10% less per difficulty level.
units.zh: 经济难度每提高一级，委托报酬降低10%。

units.source: Beginner also increases resource carrying capacity (+200 max ammo, +50 max tools, +50 max medicines) whereas on Expert, deserters take their equipment with them.
units.zh: 新手经济难度还会提高补给携带上限：弹药+200、工具+50、药品+50。专家经济难度下，逃兵会带走自己的装备。

units.source: Selling prices for various items at settlements are also reduced by 10% on Expert.
units.zh: 专家经济难度下，在定居点出售各类物品所得的价格还会降低10%。

units.source: Starting funds:{#1/} For starting gold and supplies, difficulty is tiered as high, medium and low (previously beginner/veteran/expert in older builds).
units.zh: 起始资金：{#1/}开局金币和补给分为高、中、低三档；旧版本曾将它们称为新手、老兵和专家。

units.source: Ironman mode:{#1/} Optionally, you can enable the "Ironman" mode for each difficulty level when starting a new campaign.{#2/}With this mode enabled for a campaign, the game saves automatically and the player is not able to set manual savepoints. Therefore the player has to live with every decision he makes and can not reload to a previous state other than the last autosave.
units.zh: 铁人模式：{#1/}开始新战役时，无论选择何种难度，都可以启用铁人模式。{#2/}启用后，游戏会自动保存，玩家无法手动建立存档。因此，你必须承担每次决定的后果，除了最近的自动存档，无法读取更早的游戏进度。

units.source: Things that are {#1}NOT{/#1} modified by chosen difficulty levels:
units.zh: 以下内容{#1}不受{/#1}所选难度影响：

units.source: Enemies will carry the same equipment with the same stats on all difficulty levels
units.zh: 各难度下，敌人携带的装备及其属性相同

units.source: Availability of items and supplies from towns and cities is unaffected by difficulty
units.zh: 城镇出售的物品和补给种类不受难度影响

units.source: {#1}The character's level is a value between 1 and 11 and measures experience in battle. Characters rise in levels as they gain experience and are able to increase their attributes and gain perks that make them better at the mercenary profession.{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}角色等级从1到11，反映其战斗经验。角色积累经验后会升级，得以提高属性、获得特长，从而成为更出色的佣兵。{/#1}

units.source: As {#1}mercenaries{/#1} fight and gain experience they will level up. With each level your brothers gain they receive a {#2}perk{/#2} point and can increase three different {#3}attributes{/#3}.
units.zh: {#1}佣兵{/#1}通过战斗积累经验并升级。兄弟每升一级，就会获得一个{#2}特长{/#2}点，并可提升三项不同的{#3}属性{/#3}。

units.source: The introduction of "Veteran Levels" allows mercenaries to level even farther than level 11. Every level above 11 (= Veteran Level) requires {#1}4000+1000*(current_lvl-11){/#1} XP and there is NO perk point awarded and the stat rolls are reduced to a maximum of +1 for three stats. The actual maximum level is 33 (before DLC "Warriors of the North" it was 42).
units.zh: 老兵等级使佣兵在达到11级后仍可继续升级。超过11级的每一级都属于老兵等级，需要{#1}4000+1000*(current_lvl-11){/#1}经验，不再给予特长点，所选三项属性每项最多增加+1。实际等级上限为33；在“北境勇士”DLC推出前，上限曾是42。

units.source: Attributes can be divided into two different categories:
{#1}Primary Attributes{/#1} can be increased each level by 1-4 points, depending on a character's {#2}talent{/#2}
units.zh: {#1}主要属性{/#1}每级可增加1-4点，具体取决于角色的{#2}天赋{/#2}

units.source: {#1}Secondary Attributes{/#1} can be increased each level by 2-5 points, depending on a character's {#2}talent{/#2}
units.zh: {#1}次要属性{/#1}每级可增加2-5点，具体取决于角色的{#2}天赋{/#2}

units.source: {#1/} Some recruits with military backgrounds may already have a few levels under their belt. If you hire a brother who already has one or more levels, you can distribute his perk points and stat roll level ups after you hired him as you do with a normal mercenary.
units.zh: {#1/}部分有从军经历的新兵被招募时已经升过几级。雇用这些已有等级的兄弟后，你仍可像培养其他佣兵一样，分配他们已有的特长点和升级属性点。

units.source: A character who dealt the killing blow gets 20% of the XP gained from the enemy. The other 80% is distributed equally among the combat party members.{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}4{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}{#5/}If a Wardog kills an enemy, the XP reward is divided evenly among the combat party brothers.
units.zh: 完成最后一击的角色获得该敌人经验值的20%，其余80%由所有出战成员平均分配。{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}4{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}{#5/}如果敌人被战犬击杀，则全部经验由出战的兄弟平均分配。

units.source: Some factors affect the amount of experience points gained in battle:
units.zh: 以下因素会影响战斗中获得的经验值：

units.source: The 'Beginner' combat difficulty grants {#1}+10%{/#1} {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} bonus for every character.
{#1}Training Hall{/#1} services boost the experience gain for a few battles.
units.zh: {#1}训练场{/#1}的服务可提高接下来几场战斗的经验收益。

units.source: {#1}Sparring Fight{/#1} gives {#2}+50%{/#2} {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}increase for the next battle.
{#1}Veteran's Lessons{/#1} gives {#2}+35%{/#2} {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}increase for the next 3 battles.
{#1}Rigorous Schooling{/#1} gives {#2}+20%{/#2} {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}increase for the next 5 battles.

{#1}Potion of Knowledge{/#1} gives {#2}+100%{/#2} {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3} increase in the next 3 battles and {#6}The King in Chains{/#6} potion provides a permanent {#7}+20%{/#7} {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} boost.
Character trait {#1}Bright{/#1} increases experience gain by {#2}+10%{/#2} {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}, while {#6}Dumb{/#6} characters are penalized by {#7}-15%{/#7} {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8}.

{#1}Student{/#1} perk grants additional {#2}20%{/#2} {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}. At the eleventh character level (or at the seventh character level for {#6}Indebted{/#6} when playing the {#7}Manhunters{/#7} origin) the perk becomes inert.
units.zh: {#1}好学{/#1}特长额外提供{#2}20%{/#2}{#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3}经验加成。角色达到十一级后，该效果不再生效；若选择{#7}捕奴者{/#7}起源，{#6}负债者{/#6}则在七级时失去此效果。

units.source: Some character backgrounds have different modifiers: an {#1}Apprentice{/#1} has {#2}+10%{/#2} {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3} and a {#6}Mason{/#6} has {#7}+5%{/#7} {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} innate boost, whereas a {#11}Wildman{/#11} has {#12}-15%{/#12} {#13}{#14}{#15/}{/#14}{/#13} penalty.
{#1}Manhunters{/#1} origin specific rule: any overseer (non-indebted) earns {#2}10%{/#2} {#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3} less, while any {#6}Indebted{/#6} earns {#7}10%{/#7} {#8}{#9}{#10/}{/#9}{/#8} more.

Extremely small squads get penalties to experience gain: {#1}-15%{/#1} {#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2} for two brothers, {#5}-30%{/#5} {#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6} if there is only one. Brothers in reserve are included, so bringing one brother to a battle and leaving two or more in reserve does not apply the penalty.
units.zh: 人数过少的佣兵团会受到经验惩罚：只有两名兄弟时为{#1}-15%{/#1}{#2}{#3}{#4/}{/#3}{/#2}，只有一名时为{#5}-30%{/#5}{#6}{#7}{#8/}{/#7}{/#6}。后备成员也计入人数，因此只派一名兄弟出战、同时留下至少两名后备，不会触发此惩罚。
这些经验修正以乘法叠加。{#1/}

units.source: Your soldiers aren't noble adventurers fighting for truth or justice, they are in it for the money. A company without money and supplies will quickly have no members left.
units.zh: 你的士兵不是为真理和正义而战的高尚冒险者，他们是来挣钱的。没有钱和补给，佣兵团很快就会人去营空。

units.source: Every soldier gets paid a daily wage of crowns, if you fail to pay them their {#1}mood{/#1} will decrease and they may decide to desert your company. The wage is increased by 2 crowns per level up and the {#2}character trait{/#2} greedy increases the wage right away by 2 crowns.
units.zh: 每名士兵每天都要领取克朗作为薪水。如果拖欠薪水，他们的{#1}心情{/#1}会变差，甚至可能离开佣兵团。每次升级，日薪增加2克朗；贪婪{#2}特性{/#2}会直接使日薪增加2克朗。

units.source: Each brother consumes 2 units of food per day unless they have certain {#1}traits{/#1} like spartan or gluttonous. If you fail to feed them, their mood will decrease and after a while and if angered enough, they may decide to desert your company.
units.zh: 除非具有节俭或贪食等特殊{#1}特性{/#1}，每名兄弟每天消耗2单位食物。吃不饱会让他们心情变差；持续挨饿、积怨加深后，他们可能离开佣兵团。

units.source: The quality of food currently doesn't have any effect, although there is an {#1}event{/#1} ingame, that when you have a good diversity of {#2}food{/#2} (also with high quality food like venison) that will boost the mood of your men. High quality {#3}provisions{/#3} usually take longer to spoil than lower quality provisions. Your mercenaries will always eat or drink the provisions which are the closest to spoil. {#4/}{#5/}
units.zh: 目前食物品质本身没有直接效果，但游戏中有一个{#1}事件{/#1}：当佣兵团携带多种{#2}食物{/#2}，包括鹿肉等优质食物时，可能改善成员的心情。优质{#3}食物{/#3}通常比低品质食物更耐储存。佣兵总会优先食用或饮用最接近变质的补给。{#4/}{#5/}

units.source: Battle Brothers uses a day/night cycle, going through the phases
units.zh: 《战场兄弟》采用昼夜循环，依次经历以下时段：

units.source: {#1}Dawn - Morning - Midday - Afternoon - Evening - Dusk - Night{/#1}
units.zh: {#1}黎明—上午—正午—下午—傍晚—黄昏—夜晚{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Settlement vendors{/#1} (e.g. Temples, Training Halls, Barbers, etc) are closed and not available during the Night portion of the day/night cycle. It is not possible to recruit new mercenaries during the Night either. Taverns are the only {#2}settlement building{/#2} open at any hour of the in-game day/night cycle.
units.zh: 夜晚，{#1}定居点内的服务设施{/#1}（如神殿、训练场、理发店等）会关门，也无法招募新佣兵。酒馆是唯一全天开放的{#2}定居点建筑{/#2}。

units.source: A complete day in-game is about 1 minute 45 seconds in real time. Use the {#1}Space Bar{/#1} or click the pause button next to the clock at the top of the screen to pause the game. The passage of time is also halted while in town, while in an event dialogue, or during combat. While the game is not paused on the world map, provisions will be consumed, damaged gear flagged for repair will be repaired (provided you have Tools and Supplies) and wounds will heal (provided you have Medical Supplies). Wages are paid to your mercenaries daily at noon (once Afternoon starts).
units.zh: 游戏中的一整天约等于现实中的1分45秒。按{#1}空格键{/#1}，或点击屏幕顶部时钟旁的暂停按钮，即可暂停游戏。在城镇内、事件对话中和战斗中，世界时间也会停止。在世界地图上，未暂停时会持续消耗食物；标记为修理的受损装备会得到修复（需要工具和补给），伤势也会恢复（需要医疗用品）。佣兵的薪水每天在正午结束、下午开始时支付。

units.source: Travel on the overland map is slowed during Night and sight radius is reduced, making unexpected attacks by enemy groups more likely. {#1/}{#2/}
units.zh: 夜间在世界地图上行进的速度较慢，视野范围也会缩小，因此更容易遭遇敌人的突然袭击。{#1/}{#2/}

units.source: Enemy troop sizes are influenced by many factors, the overarching one being Combat difficulty which is set at the start of the game, which increases both numbers and tier (more higher tier mobs like Brigand Leaders).
units.zh: 敌人队伍的规模受多种因素影响，其中最主要的是开局选择的战斗难度。较高难度会增加敌人数量，也会提高敌人档次，例如出现更多强盗头目。

units.source: Difficulty/enemy troop size of contracts, non-contract locations and roaming parties scale differently.{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}5{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}
units.zh: 委托、非委托地点和游荡队伍的难度及敌人规模，采用不同的增长规则。{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}5{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}

units.source: {#1}Contract difficulty{/#1} scales with the strength of your {#2}roster{/#2} (which equals a sum of individual strengths [10 + 2*(lvl-1)] of 12 strongest brothers), the {#3}difficulty rating{/#3} (skulls), the {#4}type{/#4} of contract, and some factors specific to the type of contract – for example, escort contracts are generally more difficult the longer you travel, as it increases the chance to run into enemies. Renown does not factor into contract difficulty, but it does factor heavily into contract rewards; the more renown you have, the more you'll be paid. Contract reward also scales with the difficulty rating (skulls) of contracts, which is why it offers some indication as to the contract difficulty.
units.zh: {#1}委托难度{/#1}取决于{#2}佣兵团{/#2}的实力（最强12名兄弟的个人实力之和，每人的计算式为[10 + 2*(lvl-1)]）、{#3}难度评级{/#3}（骷髅数量）、委托{#4}类型{/#4}以及该类型特有的因素。例如，护送路线越长，遭遇敌人的机会越多，通常也就越难。声望不参与委托难度计算，但会显著影响报酬：声望越高，报酬越多。报酬还受骷髅难度评级影响，因此也能在一定程度上反映委托的难易。

units.source: Difficulty of {#1}non-contract locations and roaming parties{/#1} scales mostly with {#2}distance to civilization{/#2} and {#3}time{/#3}. Roaming parties also scale slightly with player strength, but less so than contracts, and non-contract locations don't scale with player strength at all.{#4}{#5}{#6}[{/#6}6{#7}]{/#7}{/#5}{/#4}
units.zh: {#1}非委托地点和游荡队伍{/#1}的难度，主要取决于{#2}距离文明地区的远近{/#2}和{#3}游戏经过的时间{/#3}。游荡队伍还会少量参考玩家实力，但影响程度低于委托；非委托地点则完全不随玩家实力调整。{#4}{#5}{#6}[{/#6}6{#7}]{/#7}{/#5}{/#4}

units.source: Therefore, contract-spawned mobs and locations are always closely matched to the player's party and offer an appropriate challenge. As non-contract locations do not scale to the player's party strength, far-off locations will probably be risky or difficult early in the game, whereas in the late game, these become juicier targets for unique hunting, especially if the player has leveled up speedily.
units.zh: 因此，委托生成的敌人和地点通常会贴近玩家队伍的实力，提供相应的挑战。非委托地点不会按玩家实力调整，所以游戏前期探索偏远地点往往更危险；到了后期，尤其是佣兵升级较快时，这些地点就成了寻找独特装备的好目标。

units.source: Roster strength or party strength as mentioned above, takes into account number of men and their levels.{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}7{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1} Based on in-game tests, roster strength has a very significant impact on enemy troop size and composition.{#5}{#6}{#7}[{/#7}8{#8}]{/#8}{/#6}{/#5} From further testing, gear does not appear to have an impact on roster strength.
units.zh: 上文所说的佣兵团实力或队伍实力，同时考虑成员人数和等级。{#1}{#2}{#3}[{/#3}7{#4}]{/#4}{/#2}{/#1}游戏内测试表明，队伍实力对敌人的数量和构成影响很大。{#5}{#6}{#7}[{/#7}8{#8}]{/#8}{/#6}{/#5}进一步测试显示，装备似乎不影响队伍实力的计算。

units.source: Mousing over lairs usually reveals rough assessments of numbers (detailed in table below) and troop types for the defenders.
units.zh: 将鼠标移到敌方巢穴上，通常可以查看守军的大致人数（见下表）及兵种。

units.source: Your {#1}Renown{/#1} is your repute as a professional mercenary company and reflects how reliable and competent people judge you to be. The higher your {#2}Renown{/#2}, the higher the reward from {#3}Contracts{/#3} and the more difficult {#4}Contracts{/#4} people will entrust you with, and the more resources your enemies will spend on working against you. {#5}Renown{/#5} increases on successfully completing {#6}Contracts{/#6} and winning battles, and decreases on failing to do so.
units.zh: {#1}声望{/#1}代表佣兵团的职业名声，反映他人对你们可靠程度和能力的评价。{#2}声望{/#2}越高，{#3}委托{/#3}报酬越丰厚，人们也会交给你更困难的{#4}委托{/#4}，敌人则会投入更多资源来对付你。成功完成{#6}委托{/#6}、赢得战斗会提高{#5}声望{/#5}；失败则会降低声望。

units.source: The company starts between {#1}-100{/#1} and 200 {#2}Renown{/#2} upon starting a new campaign depending on the chosen {#3}Origin{/#3}. You can see your current renown at the top of the {#4}{#5}Factions & Relations{/#5} window.{/#4}
units.zh: 新战役开始时，佣兵团的初始{#2}声望{/#2}根据所选{#3}起源{/#3}，介于{#1}-100{/#1}与200之间。你可以在{#4}{#5}阵营与关系{/#5}窗口的顶部{/#4}查看当前声望。

units.source: While Battle Brothers is primarily a turn based tactical simulator, managing your funds well will go a long way towards having an easier time in hiring good men and gearing up. Buy/Sell prices of items in markets are largely determined by:{#1/} 1) Economic difficulty{#2/} 2) Settlement type/size{#3/} 3) Settlement Relations{#4/} 4) Settlement situation{#5/}
units.zh: 虽然《战场兄弟》的核心是回合制战术战斗，但管好资金，会让招募优秀成员和置办装备轻松许多。市场物品的买卖价格主要取决于：{#1/}1）经济难度{#2/}2）定居点类型与规模{#3/}3）与定居点的关系{#4/}4）定居点当前状况{#5/}

units.source: The general scheme is to buy cheaply/restock supplies at smaller settlements (trade goods, tools/medicine/etc) and and sell loot/trade goods at a profit at larger settlements. Repairing items before selling is favorable if the increase in selling price exceeds cost of tools used in repairs. Building good Relations with these settlements by doing contracts for them and taking advantage of favorable settlement situation modifiers will further increase profit margin.
units.zh: 一般做法是在小型定居点低价购买或补充贸易货物、工具、药品等物资，再到大型定居点出售战利品和贸易货物来赚取差价。如果修理带来的售价提升高于消耗工具的成本，出售前先修理装备就更划算。完成当地委托来改善关系，并利用有利的定居点状况，还能进一步提高利润。

units.zh: 无论命中与否，武器挥过的格子都会留下瘴气

units.source: A fortified wooden encampment used by outlaws to stash their loot, rest in between raids and play drinking games.
units.zh: 一处设有防御工事的木制营寨。匪徒在这里藏匿赃物，在劫掠之间休息，也少不了喝酒作乐。

units.source: An abandoned homestead with a collapsed roof.
units.zh: 一座屋顶坍塌的废弃农庄。

units.source: A once proud fortress now lying in ruins.{#1/} (southern) These ancient ruins cast their shadows far over the surrounding sands.
units.zh: 一座曾经雄伟的堡垒，如今只剩废墟。{#1/}（南方版本）这片古老遗迹的阴影长长地投在四周的沙地上。

units.source: A set of fur jurts typical for the barbarians of the northern regions.
units.zh: 几顶兽皮圆帐，是北方蛮族惯用的样式。

units.source: Barbarians have flocked to this place and set up camp around a site of worship. A lot of fierce northern warriors are likely to be found nearby.
units.zh: 蛮族聚集于此，围绕着祭祀之地扎下营地。附近很可能有大量凶悍的北方战士。

units.source: A couple of simple barbarian fur huts huddled down in a circle.
units.zh: 几间简陋的蛮族兽皮棚屋低矮地围成一圈。

units.source: A makeshift encampment erected by goblins for shelter and stashing supplies.
units.zh: 地精搭起的临时营地，用来栖身和囤积补给。

units.source: A defensible outpost erected by goblins.
units.zh: 地精修筑的一处易于防守的前哨据点。

units.source: The gates to a great underground Goblin city, its maze-like tunnels teeming with vicious greenskins.
units.zh: 这里通向一座庞大的地精地下城。迷宫般的坑道里，凶恶的绿皮成群出没。

units.source: Nomads hide their camps well to avoid unwanted visitors or pursuing soldiers of the city states.
units.zh: 游牧民善于隐藏营地，以避开不速之客和城邦的追兵。

units.source: These ancient ruins cast their shadows far over the surrounding sands.
units.zh: 古老的废墟在四周沙地上投下长长的阴影。

units.source: A large collection of colorful nomad huts and tents huddled together in the desert.
units.zh: 大片色彩鲜艳的游牧民棚屋与帐篷，在沙漠中紧密相连。

units.source: A small camp of nomad tents that can be packed up and moved quickly.
units.zh: 一处小型游牧民营地，帐篷可以迅速拆收，随时转移。

units.source: A small camp erected by Orcs, either as part of a large horde in the vicinity or a small tribes of its own. They'll eventually move on to hunt and pillage elsewhere.
units.zh: 兽人搭起的小营地，可能隶属于附近的大部落，也可能自成一支小部落。迟早，它们会转往别处狩猎和劫掠。

units.source: This cave has been occupied by greenskins and turned into a foul-smelling camp.
units.zh: 这座洞穴已被绿皮占据，成了一处恶臭熏天的营地。

units.source: A large and foul-smelling sea of tents, with a warlord's tent and throne-room in the middle, the largest of all. It's home to a whole tribe until they move on to hunt and raid elsewhere.
units.zh: 大片营帐散发着恶臭，正中央那顶最大，是军阀的居所与王座厅。整个部落暂居于此，直到前往别处狩猎和劫掠。

units.source: Sunken into the ground, this castle has been long abandoned, only to give refuge to much darker creatures.
units.zh: 这座城堡沉陷于地下，早已被人遗弃，如今却成了邪恶生物的藏身之所。

units.source: A long forgotten crypt haunted by the ghosts of the past. The dead won't find sleep here.
units.zh: 一座早被遗忘的墓穴，往昔的幽魂在其中徘徊。死者在此无法安眠。

units.source: A place where people have buried their dead, placing them down for their last rest. Or at least they hoped so.
units.zh: 人们将死者埋葬于此，愿他们长眠不醒。至少，活着的人是这么希望的。

units.source: The sad remains of a merciless battle, an epidemic or other catastrophe. The survivors dug a large hole and piled all the corpses into it to get rid of them quickly.
units.zh: 一场惨烈战事、瘟疫或其他灾难留下的凄凉遗迹。幸存者挖出大坑，将尸体层层堆入，好尽快处理这些死者。

units.source: A necromancer has made this lair his refuge for practicing dark rituals undisturbed.
units.zh: 一名亡灵法师以此为巢穴，在无人打扰的地方举行黑暗仪式。

units.source: Once a thriving human settlement, this place has been defiled and fallen into ruin, turned into a necropolis of the undead. Waves of walking corpses pour forth to spread terror and fear in the surrounding lands.
units.zh: 这里曾是繁荣的人类聚落，如今却遭亵渎、化为废墟，成了亡灵之城。成群的行尸不断涌出，将恐怖散播到周围各地。

units.source: Hidden for centuries, this ancient place became a safe haven for a coven of hemovores.
units.zh: 这处古老之地隐匿了数百年，成了一群嗜血生物的避难所。

units.source: {#1}{#2}↑{/#2}{/#1} {#3}Likely an error: {#4}{#5/}{/#4} for weapons, {#6}{#7/}{/#6} for every other type.{/#3}

When you hire a new brother, he will randomly have a series of stars next to three of his {#1}Attributes{/#1}:{#2/}{#3}{#4}{#5/}{/#4}{/#3} - 60% chance{#6/}{#7}{#8}{#9/}{/#8}{/#7} - 30% chance{#10/}{#11}{#12}{#13/}{/#12}{/#11} - 10% chance{#14/}{#15/} These denote the brother's talents. Talents allow a character to progress better than others in a certain stat. These talents are completely randomly assigned, without any connection to a background or trait. Very few exceptions apply though: some backgrounds are excluded from certain talents.{#16/}{#17/} A talent increases the additional attribute points available upon level-up. 1 star increases the minimum by 1, 2 stars by 2 and 3 stars also increase the maximum by one.{#18}{#19}{#20}[{/#20}1{#21}]{/#21}{/#19}{/#18}{#22/}

Another way to think about talents is: For stats you will always level up (Ranged Skill on archers for example), each star will add 5 points by level 11 on average. Therefore, a Hunter that starts at 55 Ranged Skill and no stars is equivalent to a Poacher that starts at 50 Ranged Skill with one star.
units.zh: 也可以这样理解天赋：对于每级都会提升的属性（例如弓箭手的远程命中），到11级时，每颗星平均能多提供5点属性。因此，初始远程命中55、没有星级的猎人，与初始远程命中50、拥有一星的偷猎者，在这项属性的预期成长结果上相当。

units.source: This applies to all stats; a Militia starting with 7 Melee Defense is equivalent to a Farmer starting at 2 Melee Defense with one star (as far as Melee Defense is concerned).
units.zh: 这一规律适用于所有属性。例如，只比较近战防御，初始7点的民兵与初始2点、拥有一星的农夫相当。

units.source: Thinking about it this way should make the importance of a character's starting stats more obvious to the player; if a character rolls a low starting stat, it's easy to compare it to losing a star!
units.zh: 这样比较，更容易看出初始属性的重要性：如果某项初始属性较低，就可以将其理解为相当于少了一颗星。

units.source: In the {#1}Northern Raiders{/#1} origin, the starting {#2}Monk{/#2} that the player gets is unique. He is guaranteed to have 3 stars in Resolve, and no stars in any other stat. This is the only character in the game that does not have stars in 3 stats.
units.zh: {#1}北境劫掠者{/#1}起源自带的{#2}僧侣{/#2}是个例外：他必定拥有3星意志，其他属性没有星级。他是游戏中唯一没有在3项属性上拥有天赋星级的角色。
